title: PRD-15 synthetic risk input syntax

insuredRefs.description: required; 1–100 authorized refs. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: INSURED_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

occupationCode.description: required; versioned risk code <= 60. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: OCCUPATION_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

activityCodes.description: required; 1–100 distinct declared categories. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: ACTIVITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

benefitPlanCode.description: required; offered death/disability/expense structure. Sensitivity: internal. Error: BENEFIT_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

beneficiaryRefs.description: conditional by benefit; authorized designation, allocation contract-validated. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: BENEFICIARY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

territoryCode.description: required; offered geographic scope <= 40. Sensitivity: internal. Error: TERRITORY_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

termCode.description: required; offered period code <= 40. Sensitivity: internal. Error: TERM_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
